summary: Frontend-only PIN login E2E verification for Panou Antrenor (ElvisPro Cut). Backend intentionally removed. All 8 scenarios in the review request PASSED: PIN keypad renders (no email/password/Google/register), invalid PIN 9999 shows 'PIN invalid' error and clears dots (stays on /login), valid PIN 1234 via keypad auto-submits at 4 digits, hidden input login with '1234' also works, dashboard shows 'Elvis Antrenor'/'Coach +', localStorage pa_trainer is set with demo trainer, session persists across reload, /projects and /dashboard render gracefully despite 502 errors from removed backend REST calls, logout clears session and returns to /login, /billing renders 8 stripe plan cards with 'Abonează-te' buttons wired to buy.stripe.com LIVE links (via onClick subscribe(p.url), not <a href> — expected).
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard/Projects pages still make REST calls to the removed backend and produce 502 console errors — noisy but expected per agent context. Consider wrapping those fetches in try/catch that no-ops when no backend is configured, to silence console error spam.

Billing 'Abonează-te' button uses onClick with a subscribe() JS handler rather than an <a href> — consider using an anchor with target=_blank rel=noopener for better a11y/SEO and to allow right-click open-in-new-tab. Functionality itself is not verified end-to-end (we did not click through to stripe LIVE URL to avoid real payment page).
test_credentials: Demo PIN 1234 from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — worked as expected
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only app. No backend. Auth = PIN via localStorage key 'pa_trainer'. Demo PIN 1234 (loginWithPin fallback when Supabase not configured). All primary flows verified working. 502 errors in console on Dashboard/Projects are expected (removed backend). Billing subscribe button uses onClick handler (subscribe function) not <a href>; do not assert on anchor tags for buy.stripe.com — count the 8 [data-testid=billing-plan-card] cards instead.
